## What changes / Что меняется

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. English or Russian is welcome.
Use `type(scope): description` for the title and new commits, for example `fix(audio): correct playback volume`.

## Validation / Проверка

List the relevant commands or manual checks, including platform and model if applicable.

- [ ] The change contains no private recordings, profiles, weights, secrets or local data.
- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated in English and Russian where needed.
